item.text: The paginator stops when a page contains fewer active records than requested, even when the gateway returns a continuation cursor. Deleted records can cause that short page. Projects use a larger scan size, which masks the bug in this example. I’ll make pagination stop only when the cursor is `null`.

item.text:
Fixed CAT-284. Pagination now follows the gateway’s continuation cursor until `null`, including short or empty pages caused by deleted records. The reported export now includes both `i-1` and `i-3`.

Added regression coverage for deleted records and empty cursor tokens. All 5 tests pass.
